votes.motion: Approve the field change for 168 West Street (smaller footprint of the proposed addition).
votes.quote: jv motioned for approval of the field change. ml seconded and the commission unanimously approved the motion by roll call vote

votes.motion: Issue a negative determination for grading within the buffer zone at 205 Sunset Lane, with the condition that the plans be revised to show erosion control.
votes.quote: a negative determination with the condition that the plans be revised to show erosion control was made by rb and a second by jr with a unanimous motion approved by roll call vote.

votes.motion: Continue the Notice of Intent hearing for the removal of an old dump site at 104 Fairview Ave to February 16.
votes.quote: the meeting was continued to february 16 by a motion of rb and a second by jv with a unanimous vote to approve by roll call vote.

votes.motion: Issue an Order of Conditions for the relocation of a drain line at 21 Brookview Terrace (Paul Gosselin).
votes.quote: a motion was made to issue an order of conditions by rb with a second by jv and a unanimous vote to approve the motion by roll call vote

votes.motion: Continue the Notice of Intent hearing for the 4-lot subdivision at 711 Massachusetts Ave to February 16.
votes.quote: a motion was made by rb to continue to february 16th with a second by jr and a unanimous vote to approve the motion by roll call vote.

votes.motion: Issue a negative determination for the removal of trees within the buffer zone at 2 Gabe's Place.
votes.quote: mm noted that the mitigation of the violation is satisfactory and recommended a negative determination. the motion was passed unanimously by a roll call vote.

votes.motion: Continue the Notice of Intent hearing for work at 445 Townsend Harbor Road to February 16.
votes.quote: continued to feb 16 by a motion of rb and second by jv with a unanimous vote to approve the motion.

votes.motion: Continue the Notice of Intent hearing for a duplex, septic and site grading at 123 Chase Road to February 16.
votes.quote: continued to february 16 by a motion of rb a second by jv and a unanimous vote to approve the roll call vote.

note: Text extraction, readable throughout but with typos and garbled words (e.g. 'itesm', 'existi ng', 'Eric Flower' for Eric Fowler). Votes are recorded only as motions with initials; I mapped initials to members using the letterhead roster (RB Richard Bursch, JV Jeffrey Viviano, ML Michael Larouche, JR Jack Rabbitt, BP Bob Pease, MM Matthew Marro, CC Catie Childs). The mapping is mine, not the minutes'. The minutes name no vote on approving prior minutes, no adjournment vote, and no roll-call tally beyond 'unanimous'. The Public Comment and Minutes of previous meetings headings have no content. Attendance is given only as 'all members present'; Richard Tremblay's attendance is not stated. Straw poll on the 711 Massachusetts Ave application is recorded as a poll, not a vote, and is excluded.
